paper.citation: T. Hossain with Claude (Anthropic), Particle decays as fixed measurements: exact noncontextuality thresholds for decay-angle correlations, generated work, 17 November 2026 (unpublished, not peer reviewed)

phases: two released nodes (GEN_HEP:m_cc, GEN_GPT_Level:e-ctx) have no route between them
a decay is modelled as one fixed covariant measurement (p-decay)
single-setting data cannot violate Bell or steering inequalities (FW3, FW4)
applied to measured top-pair and hyperon data (A1–A4)
base: Across branches: GEN_HEP v1.2 (charged-current vertex) and GEN_GPT_Level v2.6 (contextuality), glued to GEN_QRT_Level v1.2

nodes.label: All spin states of one particle
nodes.def: Density operators on C⁽²ʲ⁺¹⁾ of a particle at rest; data Bloch vector v = κ r for j = 1/2.

nodes.label: Steered ensemble
nodes.def: States of particle A conditioned on the recorded decay direction of particle B (remote preparations).

nodes.label: Unpolarised pair states
nodes.def: Two spin-1/2 particles with vanishing single-particle polarisation; correlation matrix C.

nodes.label: Top-pair spin state
nodes.def: Spin state of a t tbar pair at fixed kinematics.

nodes.label: Hyperon-pair spin state
nodes.def: Λ anti-Λ from e+ e- → J/ψ at production angle θ.

nodes.label: Decay polarimeter
nodes.def: The measurement a decay implements on the parent spin: one fixed SU(2)-covariant POVM E_w(q) = (d/4π) R_q D_w R_q† with kernel w (helicity weights of the recorded direction).

nodes.label: Spin-1/2 polarimeter
nodes.def: E(q) = (1 + κ q.σ)/4π; κ is the spin analysing power.

nodes.label: Spin-1 polarimeter
nodes.def: Kernel (w+, w₀, w-); η₁ = w+ - w-, η₂ = 1 - 3 w₀.

nodes.label: Recorded-outcome hidden-variable model
nodes.def: Local hidden-variable model of single-setting data whose hidden variables are the recorded outcomes (Kasday; Abel-Dittmar-Dreiner).

nodes.label: Noncontextual ontological model
nodes.def: Finite ontic set, convex-linear epistemic states and response functions that respect all operational equivalences of the fragment (simplex embedding).

nodes.label: Mutual tomographic completeness
nodes.def: The accessible states and effects span each other's dual space; operational equivalences are then those read off the data.

nodes.label: Decay-angle distribution
nodes.def: p(q) = Tr[ρ E_w(q)] of one particle; multipole coefficients.

nodes.label: Joint decay-angle distribution
nodes.def: (4π)² p(qA,qB) = 1 + a.qA + b.qB + qAᵀ c qB; raw coefficients (a, b, c).

nodes.label: Raw-PPT test
nodes.def: ρ_raw = (1/4)(1 + a.σ ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ b.σ + sum c_ij σ_i ⊗ σ_j) and its partial transpose are positive semidefinite; for a = b = 0: ‖c‖₁ ≤ 1.

nodes.label: Spin-1 region test
nodes.def: (η₁, η₂) outside R (all states) or the product of ratios outside R₂ (pair, one decay each).

nodes.label: Vector analysing power bound
nodes.def: |κ₁| > ξ₂ⱼ with ξ_n the largest Gauss (n even) or Gauss-Radau (n odd) node.
